sources.title: Constitution of the Republic of Kosovo, Article 35
sources.publisher: Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The Official Gazette hosts the Constitution, including Article 35's citizen-entry guarantee.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of the Republic of Kosovo shall not be denied entry into the Republic of Kosovo.

sources.title: Decision No. 21/216 amending Government Decision No. 15/158
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The Prime Minister's official domain publishes the signed Government decision amending the controlling visa-regime decision.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Botswana, Namibia and South Africa ... are subject to the regime of visas.

sources.title: Government decisions, 99th meeting: suspension of Russia exceptions
sources.publisher: Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The Official Gazette publishes the Government decision suspending Decision No. 15/158 exceptions for Russian citizens.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Russian citizens ... are obliged to obtain a visa of the Republic of Kosovo.

sources.title: Government decisions, 67th meeting: temporary suspension for Ukrainian citizens
sources.publisher: Official Gazette of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The Official Gazette publishes Government Decision No. 14/67 suspending Ukraine's entry-visa regime until a subsequent decision.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The entry visa regime for citizens of Ukraine is temporarily suspended.

sources.title: Information for foreign citizens entering the Republic of Kosovo
sources.publisher: Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The Interior Ministry's 16 January 2026 guidance gives the current short-stay and admission conditions for foreign citizens.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A foreigner may stay up to 90 days within a 180-day period, visa-free or with a visa when required.

policies.title: Kosovo ordinary passport: citizenship
policies.summary: A Kosovo national travelling on a Kosovo ordinary passport is classified as citizenship rather than as a foreign visitor-visa relationship.
conditions: Article 35 says a Kosovo citizen may not be denied entry. This does not classify a dual national presenting another country's travel document.
Residence, work, transit, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, emergency-document and final border-admission treatment are outside this classification.

policies.title: Botswana, Namibia, South Africa and Russia ordinary passports: visa required
policies.summary: A signed Government decision and the Official Gazette directly place Botswana, Namibia, South Africa and Russia under Kosovo's visa regime.
conditions: Decision No. 21/216 directly subjects Botswana, Namibia and South Africa to the visa regime.
For Russia, the Gazette decision requires a Kosovo visa even for ordinary, official and diplomatic passport holders and holders of listed Schengen documents.
This does not establish eVisa, ETA or nationality-wide visa-on-arrival access. The current Interior guidance retains travel-document, purpose, means, registration and final-admission conditions.

policies.title: Ukraine ordinary passport: temporary visa waiver
policies.summary: Government Decision No. 14/67 temporarily suspends Kosovo's entry-visa regime for Ukrainian citizens until a later Government decision.
conditions: The Gazette says the suspension remains effective until a subsequent Government decision; recheck it before any publication because it has no stated end date.
This establishes no eVisa, ETA, arrival-visa, work, residence or special-document entitlement. Ordinary admission requirements remain applicable.

conflicts.explanation: Signed Decision No. 21/216 subjects Botswana to Kosovo's visa regime.
Signed Decision No. 21/216 subjects Namibia to Kosovo's visa regime.
